title: Every connected graph has two non-cut vertices
statement: Let $G$ be a finite connected simple graph with at least two vertices. Then $G$ has two distinct vertices $u$ and $v$, neither of which is a cut vertex.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph
the vertex set has at least two vertices (nontrivial)
replaced:
\emph{Every nontrivial loopless connected graph has at least two
vertices that are not cut vertices.}
